name: CJ Seafood Corporation
summary: CJ Seafood Corporation, based in South Korea, is dedicated to the production and processing of a diverse range of seafood items. Their offerings encompass fish cakes, various meat products, seaweed, and an assortment of refrigerated and frozen food options. These products are distributed under the brand names Samho Fish Cake and Samho Masal, both domestically and through international export channels. Founded in 1976, the company was initially known as Samho F&G, Inc. before rebranding as CJ Seafood Corporation in 2010. Its headquarters are located in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
